diff_table.current_state: Dead-code and production-readiness findings include false positives mixed with true issues.

diff_table.current_state: Resume task-selection duplication creates drift risk between /wiki-resume and codewiki_resume_context.

diff_table.rationale: CodeWiki task policy requires executable tasks rather than coordination-only aggregate tasks.
diff_table.risk: Medium during implementation: large-file refactors need characterization tests.
